description: Figure 5 presents the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold after gating, with a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are plotted: a solid blue line with circular markers, a dashed orange line with circular markers, and a dash-dot purple line with circular markers. The solid blue line begins at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, declines to approximately 0.2 at layer 5, and remains relatively stable around 0.2 until layer 20. The dashed orange line starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, declines to approximately 0.1 at layer 5, and remains relatively stable around 0.1 until layer 20. The dash-dot purple line begins at approximately 0.75 at layer 0, declines to approximately 0.1 at layer 5, and remains relatively stable around 0.1 until layer 20.
